messages:
Jordan: Heads up — sunlight + glossy monitor = instant potato. Temporary setup hack: cookie sheet as a laptop riser + blackout clip on the window. pic: https://imgur.com/xyz123. Also, weirdly, Wi‑Fi improved after I shoved the router on top of the bookcase (professional engineering).
Maya: love the cookie sheet trick 😂 did you actually climb up to move the router?
Jordan: yep, ladder + dignity on the line. ran a quick check: `ping 8.8.8.8 && speedtest-cli --simple` -> 24 ms / 120 Mbps / 42 Mbps
Ryan: pro tip: a little aluminum foil folded behind the monitor can nudge signal into the room. looks ridiculous, works surprisingly well. dramatic slapping noise included.
Sophia: wait is foil ok around the cat? pls no tinfoil hats for pets 🐱
Jordan: cat approved. he immediately turned the cookie sheet into a bed. pic: https://imgur.com/catbed456 (he demands treats)
Alex: tiny poll: standing desk or sitting desk? react with :standing_person: for standing, :chair: for sitting, or :cat: if you let the cat decide.
Maya: :chair: — but only with 15-minute stare-out-the-window breaks.
ops-bot: Reminder: ISP FastFiber scheduled firmware update in ~2 hours that may cause brief outages.
Ryan: of course the update is in 2 hours. any last-minute hotspot tips? tethering usually saves me.
Jordan: quick cheats: macOS -> hold Option and click Wi‑Fi to pick your phone hotspot fast. Android -> Settings -> Network & internet -> Hotspot. Or bribe someone with cookies.
Sophia: tally so far: :chair: 2, :standing_person: 0, :cat: 1. Jordan wins by cat power.
Maya: also, if anyone wants the cookie-sheet dimensions and clip model, I’ll post measurements and the Amazon link. weirdly ergonomic.
Jordan: posting dims in 10. also, if anyone notices weird flicker after the firmware update, try power-cycling the router once (old but gold).
